name: Indomaret Run 2026
short_description: Indomaret Run 2026 is on Sunday 22 November 2026 from SPIKE Airdome at PIK2, over 5 km, 10 km and 21 km.
ai_summary: Indomaret Run 2026 takes place on Sunday 22 November 2026, based at SPIKE Airdome in PIK2 on the northern edge of Greater Jakarta. It offers 5 km, 10 km and a 21 km half marathon, and is named for Indomaret, the Indonesian convenience-store chain.

faqs.question: When is Indomaret Run 2026?
faqs.answer: Sunday 22 November 2026, in PIK2, starting from SPIKE Airdome. Indonesian road races start before dawn to avoid the heat, so expect a very early flag-off and plan transport to the start the night before rather than on the morning.

faqs.question: What distances does Indomaret Run 2026 offer?
faqs.answer: Three: 5 km, 10 km and a 21 km half marathon. The half marathon is the headline distance, and the shorter races are aimed at newer runners and those who want a faster morning. Entry fees and cut-off times are set by the organiser, so check the official registration page before entering.
